items.name: build-your-own-x
items.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
items.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

items.name: Hyprland
items.summary: Hyprland 是一款面向注重效率与美感的用户的动态平铺 Wayland 合成器。它通过简洁的文本配置文件实现深度自定义，让用户自由调整窗口布局、动画效果和视觉样式，兼顾自动平铺的便捷与桌面的美观。技术上，它利用现代 GPU 特性实现流畅渲染，并保持资源占用高效。开发者可通过插件扩展其功能，普通用户也能轻松调出心仪的视觉风格。无论你是追求极致的键盘工作流，还是希望桌面既好看又好用，Hyprland 都提供了理想的解决方案。
items.summary_en: Hyprland is a dynamic tiling Wayland compositor designed for users who want both productivity and aesthetics. It combines automatic window management with deep configurability through plain text configuration files, allowing fine-grained control over layouts, animations, and visual effects. Technically, it achieves smooth rendering by leveraging modern GPU features and efficient resource management. Developers and power users can extend it via plugins or customize every aspect of the desktop experience. Ideal for those who want a visually stunning, keyboard-driven workflow on Linux.

items.name: outlines
items.summary: Outlines 是一个让LLM生成结构化输出的Python库，解决大模型输出不可控、难以解析的痛点。它通过约束解码或语法引导技术，在生成时动态调整token概率，确保输出严格遵循预定义格式（如JSON、正则表达式或上下文无关文法）。使用极简：只需定义输出结构（例如Pydantic模型），调用 outlines.generate 即可获得符合规则的结果。这一能力特别适合构建可靠的数据抽取管道、API后端或需要精确工具调用的智能体——无需后处理或多次提示，一次生成即可直接使用。
items.summary_en: Outlines is a Python library that forces LLMs to generate structured outputs like JSON, regex, or CFG, solving the problem of unreliable free-text responses. It uses constrained decoding or grammar-based guidance to shape token probabilities during generation, ensuring outputs strictly follow a predefined schema. You can integrate it with any LLM via a simple API: define your output structure (e.g., a Pydantic model) and call outlines.generate — useful for building reliable data extraction pipelines, API backends, or tool-using agents.

items.name: cloudflare_temp_email
items.summary: cloudflare_temp_email 是一个基于 Cloudflare 的免费临时域名邮箱服务，专为保护隐私而生，提供一次性邮箱地址以防垃圾邮件。它利用 Cloudflare Workers 和 Pages 实现无服务器部署，无需自建服务器即可运行。技术亮点在于支持附件、IMAP、SMTP 以及 Telegram Bot 集成，让收发邮件方式更灵活。你可以轻松部署到自己的 Cloudflare 账户，自定义域名，并通过 Telegram 实时接收邮件通知。非常适合用于网站注册验证、临时收信或隐私保护场景。
items.summary_en: Cloudflare_temp_email is a free temporary domain email service that protects your privacy by providing disposable email addresses. It leverages Cloudflare Workers and Pages for serverless deployment, making it easy to set up without managing your own infrastructure. Technically, it supports attachments, IMAP, SMTP, and Telegram bot integration, offering flexible ways to send and receive emails. You can deploy it on your own Cloudflare account, customize the domain, and use Telegram to receive notifications—ideal for account sign-ups or spam filtering.

items.name: Pumpkin
items.summary: Pumpkin 是一个用 Rust 开发的高性能 Minecraft Bedrock 版服务器，旨在让每个人都能轻松托管快速、高效的服务器。其核心优势在于 Rust 语言的内存安全和零成本抽象，使得即便在高玩家并发下也能保持低资源消耗和高吞吐量。你可以通过 Docker 快速部署，或从源码编译，并利用插件系统或直接修改协议来定制服务器功能，非常适合需要稳定、低延迟体验的社区或模组服务器。
items.summary_en: Pumpkin is a high-performance Minecraft Bedrock Edition server written in Rust, designed to make hosting fast and efficient servers accessible to everyone. Its core strength lies in Rust's memory safety and zero-cost abstractions, enabling high concurrency and low resource usage even for large player counts. You can quickly deploy Pumpkin using Docker or compile it from source, then customize it with plugins or direct protocol modifications for your community.

items.name: i-have-adhd
items.summary: i-have-adhd 是一个为编程助手（如Claude）设计的技能插件，能强制助手输出简洁直接的回答，避免冗长或隐藏答案的问题。其原理是拦截助手的输出，过滤掉无关内容，将关键答案前置显示，从而减轻用户的阅读负担。实际使用时，只需将此技能附加到你的编程助手，就能在调试或查询代码时立即获得所需答案，无需浏览多余信息，特别适合注意力不易集中的开发者提升效率。
items.summary_en: i-have-adhd is a skill plugin for coding agents like Claude that ensures answers are delivered concisely and upfront, solving the problem of verbose or buried responses. It works by intercepting the agent's output and reformatting it to highlight the key answer first, reducing cognitive load. Practical use: attach this skill to your coding assistant for instant, actionable answers without scrolling through irrelevant details, ideal for quick debugging or code lookups.

items.name: pi-web
items.summary: pi-web 是为 pi 编码代理提供的 Web 用户界面，让开发者能够通过浏览器直接与 AI 助手交互，进行代码生成与调试操作。项目采用 TypeScript 构建，界面简洁、响应式，模拟终端的交互方式。你可以将其本地部署，快速体验 pi 代理的能力，或将其嵌入现有开发流程，无需频繁切换上下文。这一设计降低了 AI 编码代理的使用门槛，特别适合快速原型设计。通过观察代理与代码的交互，你还能深入理解大语言模型驱动的编码工具的实际工作机制，是学习和实验 LLM 应用的不错起点。
items.summary_en: pi-web is a web-based user interface for the pi coding agent, making it easy for developers to interact with an AI assistant for code generation and debugging directly in the browser. Built with TypeScript, it offers a clean, responsive design that mirrors terminal-like interactions. You can run it locally to experiment with the pi agent or integrate it into your development workflow without switching contexts. Ideal for rapid prototyping and learning how LLM-driven coding agents work in practice.

items.name: bge-small-en-v1.5
items.summary: BGE-small-en-v1.5 是一个高效的英文句子嵌入模型，能够将文本转换为语义丰富的向量表示，专门解决文档相似度计算和语义搜索问题。它通过对比学习结合困难负样本挖掘，并采用知识蒸馏技术从大模型中学习，在保持轻量级的同时实现了优异的性能表现。开发者可将其用于构建智能检索系统、文档聚类分析，或作为RAG架构中的编码器，特别适合部署在计算资源有限的环境中探索语义理解应用。
items.summary_en: BGE-small-en-v1.5 is a compact English sentence embedding model that converts text into meaningful numerical representations for semantic similarity tasks. It employs contrastive learning with hard negatives and knowledge distillation from larger models, achieving strong performance despite its small size. You can use it for semantic search, clustering similar documents, or as a lightweight encoder in retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, making it ideal for resource-constrained applications.

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。

items.name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2
items.summary: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2是基于BERT的轻量级文本排序模型，专为语义搜索和信息检索优化。通过知识蒸馏技术压缩大型模型的语义理解能力，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算成本。该模型可应用于智能搜索、文档检索和内容推荐系统，通过编码文本对并计算相似度实现精准语义匹配，尤其适合高效处理海量文本数据的场景。

items.name: electra-base-discriminator
items.summary: ELECTRA-base-discriminator是一种基于判别式预训练的Transformer模型，通过将掩码语言建模改为区分真实与生成器产生的替代标记，显著提升训练效率。其核心创新是使用小型生成器产生替代标记，再由判别器识别真假，比BERT等模型训练更快且性能强劲。开发者可通过Hugging Face库微调该模型，应用于文本分类、命名实体识别或问答任务，特别适合计算资源有限但需要高质量语言理解的场景。
